title: TNW | The heart of tech
content:
Cursor's new ₹649 India plan runs on its own models, not OpenAI's or Anthropic's. That is how it can charge a third of the Pro price and still call it sustainable.

The eBPF-based startup says its Series C, led by One Peak, will fund a push against legacy incumbents in North America.

Andrew Ng's LearnVector wants AI agents to tutor white-collar workers one-on-one. Coursera, which he co-founded and still chairs, is funding it with $100m for a third of the company.

The country’s internet regulator wants platforms to detect, block, and log online harassment, including abuse produced with AI.
